solvers.label: FreeCAD
solvers.description: FreeCAD Python API adapter. Run with a Python environment that can import FreeCAD and Part.

input_files.freecad_smoke.py:
import FreeCAD as App
import Part

doc = App.newDocument("SimFEA_FreeCAD_Smoke")
box = Part.makeBox(10, 10, 10)
Part.show(box)
doc.recompute()
doc.saveAs("freecad_smoke.FCStd")
Part.export([box], "freecad_smoke.step")
print("freecad_artifact=freecad_smoke.step")

solvers.label: PrePoMax
solvers.description: PrePoMax command-line adapter placeholder. Use -f to import geometry or -r with -g No for regeneration workflows.

input_files.README.prepomax.txt: PrePoMax CLI smoke run. For geometry import use: PrePoMax -f model.step -u MM_TON_S_C. For automation use: PrePoMax -r model.pmx -g No -w workdir.

solvers.label: PrePoMax Regenerate
solvers.description: Headless PrePoMax regeneration workflow. Provide model.pmx and related geometry files in the run workdir.

input_files.README.prepomax-regenerate.txt: PrePoMax regeneration template. Add model.pmx and required geometry files to this workdir, then run: PrePoMax -r model.pmx -g No -w .

solvers.label: OpenFOAM
solvers.description: OpenFOAM adapter. Replace input_files with a real case before production runs.
solvers.command_template: foamDictionary -help >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo 'OpenFOAM adapter ready'; touch result.txt

input_files.README.simfea.txt: OpenFOAM adapter placeholder. Replace input_files with a real OpenFOAM case in .simfea/config.json.

input_files.case.sif:

End
Simulation

  Output File = case.result
End
